title: What percentage of bonds have the most common combination of atoms' element
question:
What percentage of bonds have the most common combination of atoms' elements?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: DIVIDE(COUNT(bond_id), COUNT(atom_id where MAX(COUNT(atom_id)) ))

prediction.sql:
WITH bond_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        c.XCL_009 AS bond_id,
        CASE WHEN a1.XCL_003 <= a2.XCL_003 THEN a1.XCL_003 || '|' || a2.XCL_003
             ELSE a2.XCL_003 || '|' || a1.XCL_003 END AS combo
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.XCL_001 = c.XCL_007
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.XCL_001 = c.XCL_008
    WHERE c.XCL_009 IS NOT NULL
),
cnt AS (
    SELECT combo, COUNT(bond_id) AS n
    FROM bond_pairs
    GROUP BY combo
),
top AS (
    SELECT MAX(n) AS max_n FROM cnt
)
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.n = t.max_n THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond_pairs)
FROM cnt c CROSS JOIN top t;

WITH pairs AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN a1.XCL_003 <= a2.XCL_003 THEN a1.XCL_003 || '|' || a2.XCL_003
         ELSE a2.XCL_003 || '|' || a1.XCL_003 END AS combo,
    c.XCL_009 AS bond_id
  FROM connected c
  JOIN atom a1 ON a1.XCL_001 = c.XCL_007
  JOIN atom a2 ON a2.XCL_001 = c.XCL_008
  WHERE c.XCL_009 IS NOT NULL
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT combo, COUNT(bond_id) AS n
  FROM pairs
  GROUP BY combo
),
top AS (
  SELECT MAX(n) AS max_n FROM cnt
)
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.n = t.max_n THEN c.n ELSE 0 END) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pairs)
FROM cnt c CROSS JOIN top t;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH bond_elements AS (
    SELECT
        b.XCL_004 AS bond_id,
        a1.XCL_003 AS elem1,
        a2.XCL_003 AS elem2
    FROM bond b
    JOIN connected c1 ON b.XCL_004 = c1.XCL_009
    JOIN connected c2 ON b.XCL_004 = c2.XCL_009
    JOIN atom a1 ON c1.XCL_007 = a1.XCL_001
    JOIN atom a2 ON c2.XCL_008 = a2.XCL_001
    WHERE c1.XCL_007 <> c2.XCL_008
),
element_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN elem1 < elem2 THEN elem1 ELSE elem2 END AS e1,
        CASE WHEN elem1 < elem2 THEN elem2 ELSE elem1 END AS e2,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
most_common AS (
    SELECT e1, e2, cnt
    FROM element_pairs
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    CAST(mc.cnt AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM most_common mc
